judge_notes.opus5: Every guide direction on this name has produced a double-digit move, and the ingredients lean up: prior-authorization submissions (management's own stated leading indicator) improving, the coding/WISeR drag decreasing sequentially, the single FY consensus sitting $6m below the guide midpoint so a narrowing or a raised low end is the likely action, new Category I CPT codes removing the 2028 structural question, Nyxoah cutting its own ramp, and 15.9% of float short and building into the print. The $66 price above most published targets is the offset.
judge_notes.opus55: The CFO's deliberately wide FY range set up a narrowing or a raised low end (i1), with a building 16% short (i4); partly offset by the stock already trading above most targets (i6).
judge_notes.sonnet55: Consensus on guide midpoint with a four-quarter beat record and a cautious FY range that can narrow up; 16% building short but spot now above most targets.
judge_notes.fable51: A $40M-wide FY range with one quarter left and a CFO who said he was being cautious about narrowing (i1) sets up a raised low end if Q3 lands at the top of its guide, with shorts building 7% into the print (i4); the stock trading above most targets (i6) caps the lean.
